title: Nri A Na-atụghị Anya Ya nke Okenye ahụ
intro: N'ebe dị nsọ nke Ụlọ Allah, otu ohu Chineke meworo agadi nwetara ihe omimi dị omimi nke na-emegide atụmanya niile. Onye a raara onwe ya nye, ogologo oge gara aga nke ịbụ nne na nna ebumpụta ụwa, hụrụ ihe pụrụ iche nke kpughere ebere Chineke na-enweghị njedebe. Ihe mgbagwoju anya dị n'ikpughe oge a echefuru echefu site na ndụ ndị amụma.
clues: A maara ndị m dịka Izrel, ụmụ nke otu nna ochie ochie.
E tinyere m abalị niile n'ekpere, na-akpọ isiala nye Onyenwe m n'ụlọ nsọ.
E nyere m nwa nwoke mgbe m mere agadi, onyinye m na-anaghị akwụsị ito Chineke maka ya.
Ọnwụnwa m gụnyere ịchọta ihe oriri nke pụtara nye otu nwa ọhụrụ nọ n'okpuru nlekọta m.
Abụ m onye amụma aha ya bụ Zakariyya, onye ọrụ ya bụ ilekọta Meri n'ime Bayt al-Maqdis.
Azịza ya dị n'amaokwu ebe Allah nabatara Meri ma nye ya ihe oriri.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
